newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Citibank to centralise admin in Dublin - reports.
newsitem.headline: Citibank to centralise admin in Dublin - reports.

text.p: Citibank, the largest U.S. bank, is close to reaching an agreement to centralise the "back office" administration for virtually all its European operations in Dublin, newspaper reports said on Monday.
They said Citibank is expected to receive five million punts in grant aid for a European administration headquarters in Dublin which would employ 700 people.
The project is expected to go before the board of industrial development agency IDA Ireland in two weeks' time and is likely to be put before government for formal approval in November.

Citibank currently has separate administration operations in nearly every country in Europe and the centralisation of these operations is expected to save the U.S. bank one third of its administrative costs.
The arrival of Citibank would be a major boost to a campaign begun earlier this year by IDA Ireland to attract big overseas banks to locate back-office operations in Dublin.
IDA Ireland does not comment on projects under negotiation.
